learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students by complementing their theoretical and practical learning.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of technical, methodological, personal, and participatory competencies.
Gain practical experience that facilitates entry into the job market and improves future employability.
Promote the values of innovation, creativity, and entrepreneurship.

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering whose purpose, according to the knowledge acquired as established in section 5 of Order CIN/351/2009 of February 9, is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to manage specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan within the company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the profession of Industrial Technical Engineer.

teaching_methods: Activities developed during the internships themselves (workday adapted to the circumstances of the collaborating entity and the student)
Monitoring by the academic tutor and the tutor from the collaborating entity

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation by the tutor at the collaborating entity
Degree of achievement of the objectives of the internship training project
Content and quality of the final internship report and its presentation and defense

assessment_rules: The academic tutor will assign the grade based on the following weighting: evaluation by the tutor at the collaborating entity (50%), degree of achievement of the internship training project objectives (25%), and content and quality of the final internship report and its presentation and defense (25%). The use of unpermitted materials during evaluation may result in withdrawal from the exam and a failing grade of '0'. Academic fraud may lead to disciplinary action.
